description: The three-argument form of `type` creates a class; a class statement does the same after running its body.
The dict of attributes and functions that becomes the class `__dict__`; functions in it become methods.
Creates a class like a class statement would: resolves the metaclass, calls `__prepare__` and passes class keywords.
A factory for tuple subclasses with named fields: immutable, indexable, and equal to plain tuples with the same items.
Builds a dataclass from a list of field names or `(name, type, field)` tuples at runtime.
